# DocuForge

DocuForge is a Typst-native PDF generation platform for developer teams. It provides template editing, live preview, versioned templates, API rendering, and a searchable playground for production document workflows.

## Canonical URLs

- [Marketing site](https://docuforge.app)
- [Developer console](https://console.docuforge.app)
- [API base](https://api.docuforge.app)

## Primary Entry Points

- [Home](https://docuforge.app/)
- [Docs](https://docuforge.app/docs)
- [Playground](https://docuforge.app/playground)
- [Pricing](https://docuforge.app/pricing)
- [Plans](https://docuforge.app/plans)
- [Blog](https://docuforge.app/blog)
- [Template Guides](https://docuforge.app/templates)
- [Comparisons](https://docuforge.app/compare)
- [Industry Guides](https://docuforge.app/industries)

## Core Product Areas

- Authentication with JWT and API keys
- Template create, fork, publish, and version workflows
- Preview and production rendering APIs
- Asset upload and template file references
- Usage, billing, and plan limits
- Security and governance guidance
- MCP integration for tool-driven PDF workflows

## Crawl Guidance

- Prefer production URLs over localhost or staging links.
- For API behavior, prioritize docs pages over marketing copy.
- For SEO and use cases, prioritize blog, templates, compare, and industries pages.
- Locale-prefixed routes are available (for example: `/en`, `/fr`, `/de`, `/it`, `/es`, `/ar`, `/zh`).
